title: IHateWater
description: A plugin that challenges you to survive without touching water!
body:
## IHateWater
This plugin makes you unable to touch water -- just like a cat!
You have to find a way to avoid touching water, or you'll go kaboom!
The main goal for players is to defeat the Ender Dragon. Have fun!
